description:
Give builders one maintained route from installation to a working core Agent and optional AI Agent.

Exit criteria:
- One canonical route supports both core and AI paths.
- The core path works without an API key.
- The AI path uses an explicit provider and model.
- The optional control path demonstrates principal context, fail-closed authorization, policy, quotas, causal history, telemetry, and redaction.
- All public onboarding code uses one API and has a matching test.

Backlog tasks: 41

Source: Jido Site Improvement Backlog 2026-07-23.md
title: E05 — Create one tested onboarding path
